requirements.title: Recruiting and workforce pool
requirements.required_screens: Requisition/capacity board, candidate pipeline, qualifications/matching, interviews, offer/version/acceptance, rejection/return/retention
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Requisition → sourcing/deduplication → evidence review → interview → offer → authenticated acceptance → employment/assignment. Deterministic matching reports complete scan status. Handle changed vacancy, repeat applicant, withdrawal/expiry and identity conflict. Accepted terms survive hiring; no automatic permanent rejected-candidate pool.

requirements.title: Contracts, staffing and sites
requirements.responsible_profiles: contract operator, planner, site lead, worker
requirements.required_screens: Contract-linked demand, allocation/calendar/map, legal applicability, qualification/conflict inspector, readiness/replacement
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Model subcontract, dispatch and own-factory operations without a worker-type shortcut. Bind clauses, demand, employer, direction/acceptance, rates and hazards independently. Client requests follow legally appropriate paths; safety stop-work remains possible. Invalid plans never erase actual work.

requirements.title: Attendance
requirements.required_screens: My shift/punch, roster, raw-event/break timeline, source comparison, corrections, period preview/close/reopen
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Schedule → exact actual intervals → reconciliation → confirmation → close → retro correction. Handle overnight/KST boundaries, missing/duplicate events, actual breaks/waiting, holidays, denied GPS/device/network, unapproved overtime and paid periods. No fabricated breaks/down-rounding. Recompute paid and billable consequences separately.

requirements.title: Leave, benefits and welfare
requirements.required_screens: Entitlement ledger, calendar, requests/eligibility, accrual/promotion simulator, benefit catalog/claims/adjustments
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Version statutory/contractual rules and accrual lots. Eligibility/coverage → decision → consumption → cancellation/retro correction. Include protected leave, changed employment/headcount, partial-day units, concurrent requests, failed promotion service and negative adjustments. Restrict medical details; no mandatory generic medical-reason collection.

requirements.title: Payroll, retirement and year-end
requirements.required_screens: Population/coverage, source readiness, calculation/rule trace, comparison, approval, payslip/publication, transfer reconciliation, retro/year-end/severance
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Include proration, hourly/monthly work, overtime/night/holiday, absence/leave, multiple employment, ordinary/average/minimum bases, separate tax/insurance bases/caps/rounding, deductions/refunds and DB/DC/IRP/severance. Distinguish liability, approval, cash submission/partial/unknown/settled, journals and document delivery. Account for every target person and amount. Payslip timing does not wait blindly for bank success.

requirements.title: Performance, feedback and engagement
requirements.required_screens: Cycle/rubric/goals, authenticated self-review, evidence/calibration, response/appeal, restricted history
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Criteria → evidence → actual subject self-review → evaluation → calibration → notice/response → finalization/correction. Handle changed evaluator, missing review and concurrent employment. Bind rubric/result versions; explain deterministic adverse decisions. No model scoring, impersonated self-review or overwritten assessment.

requirements.title: Work hub, calendar and notifications
requirements.required_screens: Overview/planner, task board/detail, recurring series, personal/team/resource calendar, RSVP, notes, announcements/receipts/preferences
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Task/dependency → schedule → evidence → close/reopen. Preserve series identity and occurrence exceptions. Handover covers absence, overload and instruction. Resolve resource/timezone/series conflicts. Notification failure differs from legal service. No video-conferencing or transcription service is added.

requirements.title: Approvals and electronic decisions
requirements.required_screens: Draft, impact/review, inbox, assent/signature intent, execution/reconciliation, amendment/reversal
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Exact artifact/version/authority → independent decision → current-policy execution → receipt → reconciliation. Cover changed payload, two accounts, revoked delegation, route/quorum/conflict, rejection/expiry and partial effects. Authentication is not document assent. Correction work may begin before its future result exists.

requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Evidence-based opportunity → proposal → won/lost → contract → delivery → renewal. Record relationship/purpose, owner, stage facts, amount/date and renewal series. Deduplicate, hand over leavers and reopen mistakes. Forecasts disclose assumptions and missing data.

requirements.title: Contracts, tenders and grants
requirements.required_screens: Clause/version comparison, rates/obligations, tender/grant checklist, assent, obligation calendar, variations/disputes/renewal
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Monthly/headcount/time/output/mixed formulas, acceptance criteria, caps, indexation, SLA, tax and effective changes. Review/assent → obligations → actual acceptance → variation/dispute → close/renew/recovery. Trace staffing/pay/bill results to clauses. Internal checkboxes are not counterparty evidence.

requirements.title: Procurement, finance and accounting
requirements.required_screens: Budgets/commitments, requisition/PO, receiving/matching, invoices/credits, AR/AP, journals/trial balance, bank reconciliation, close
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Need → PO → partial receipt → invoice match → liability/posting → payment/collection → reconciliation → adjustment. Include returns, duplicate invoice, FX/tax, partial settlement and locked periods. Ledgers balance and remain immutable; close races serialize. Do not blend legal ledgers or double-count dimensions.

requirements.title: Inventory and warehouse
requirements.required_screens: Item/unit/lot/bin, putaway, availability/reservation, replenishment, pick/pack/ship, holds, count/discrepancy
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Receive → inspect/quarantine → putaway → reserve → ship → return/count adjustment. Preserve conversions, serial/lot/expiry genealogy and partial movements. Serialize contested quantities, split/merge and reservations. Imports cannot create negative stock or defeat holds. Balances reconcile to movements.

requirements.title: Manufacturing/MES
requirements.required_screens: BOM/routing/order, resource dispatch, operation capture, materials/genealogy, quality, Andon/OEE/cost
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Demand → reserve → release → operations/consumption → inspection → finished lot → cost/acceptance. Include scrap, rework, substitution, split/merge, downtime and recall. Conserve materials/labor/output; expose actual OEE denominators.

requirements.title: Assets, equipment and maintenance
requirements.required_screens: Asset/custody/site, history, preventive series, work-order planner, parts/downtime/cost, disposal
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Acquire → commission → assign → inspect/maintain → return/retire. Track condition, safety dates, custody, parts, labor and evidence. Handle loss, missing parts, overlapping downtime and canceled occurrences. Unsafe assets cannot be allocated; approval is not completion or collection.

requirements.title: Field service, logistics and dispatch
requirements.required_screens: Capacity/vehicle/resource plan, routes/consignments, responsive job pack, evidence, POD/acceptance, disputes/cost
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Request → suitable allocation/load → travel/start → perform/handoff → partial acceptance/dispute → payable/billable outputs. Handle wrong site, reassignment, safety refusal, failed delivery, return/damage, clock/network failures. Label unsent input honestly; preserve confirmed work. Show solver/route/capacity limits.

requirements.title: Compliance, safety, privacy and audit
requirements.required_screens: Applicability/obligations, rule impact, inspections/incidents, rights requests, retention/holds/erasure, audit/legal production
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Official source + actual facts → prevent/detect → assign/remediate → independent verification → closure → retention/deletion. Handle conflicting/future rules, actual dispatch, accidents/stop-work, rights/hold conflicts and misuse. Show evidence/reasons/uncertainty, not a legal-pass score.

requirements.title: Support and knowledge
requirements.required_screens: Portal/inbox, tickets, assignment/SLA calendars, knowledge, escalation/problem/reopen
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Intake/email correlation → classification → one owner → investigation → resolution → response → close/reopen/problem. Version timers/calendars and deduplicate escalations. Contract SLA differs from platform SLO. Support access is scoped/time-limited/audited; a reply alone does not resolve an obligation.

requirements.title: Documents, evidence and office
requirements.required_screens: Library/search, editor/version/compare, quarantine, extraction/mapping, connected workbook, export/delivery
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: External mail/file → original → scan/parse/OCR → typed staging → repair → governed native action → interoperable response. Preserve page/cell/region, hidden-content classification, units/locale, formulas and original/derived linkage. Handle encryption, malware, malformed formats, edit conflicts and partial conversion.

requirements.title: Mail, messenger, polls and collaboration
requirements.required_screens: Mailbox/thread/compose/queue/bounce, E2EE rooms/DMs/search, device/recovery, calendar links, polls, archive/legal export
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Hosted mail and E2EE work messages with attachments, edits/redactions and offboarding-safe history. Explicit poll electorate/options/closure/duplicate prevention. Anonymous responses require unlinkable permits and privacy-safe publication, not merely hidden names.

requirements.title: Integrated facilities management
requirements.required_screens: Facility/service/SLA overview, obligation plan, triage, safe scheduling, work evidence, acceptance, energy/cost
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Obligation → triage → hazards/readiness → schedule → service/inspection → customer acceptance/dispute → SLA/cost. Track actual units/readings/denominators. Missed service creates recovery work. No fabricated savings or self-certified customer acceptance.

requirements.title: Rental and lifecycle commerce
requirements.required_screens: Availability/suitability, quote/contract, reservation, handover/condition, return, refurbishment/resale/redeployment
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Asset → quote/contract → exclusive reservation → handover → service → return/dispute → charges → repair/redeploy/resale. Preserve custody, condition and quantity/value accounting. Handle overlaps, unsafe assets, late/lost return and disputed damage.

requirements.title: Consulting and improvement
requirements.required_screens: Diagnostic/project workspace, findings/evidence, initiative comparison, execution plan, benefit/sustainment
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Diagnose → review findings → select initiative → execute → verify measured result → sustain/correct. Bind baseline, grain, assumptions, deliverables and customer acceptance. Missing baseline or changed conditions cannot become claimed savings.

requirements.title: Training and qualifications
requirements.required_screens: Course/requirement/recurrence catalog, enrollment, sessions/attendance, assessment, verified completion, certificate/expiry/renewal, transcript
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Completion updates effective qualification evidence and actual assignment eligibility. Verify issuer/identity; handle failed, expired, withdrawn or partial completion. Attendance is not a passed assessment. Corrections invalidate affected future allocation and open repair work.

requirements.title: Independent reporting
requirements.responsible_profiles: reporter, protected case handler, independent identity custodians
requirements.required_screens: Anonymous/sealed-identity intake, safe receipt/access secret, independent triage/conflict routing, investigation/evidence, identity-opening ceremony, remedy/closure/control improvement
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Bypass ordinary line management. No identity/IP logs for anonymous intake. Named identity is separately sealed; opening requires requesting custodian plus another authorized custodian and step-up. Ninety-day protective monitoring is an operating default, not a statutory limit. Relevant adverse personnel actions enter independent protection review.

requirements.title: Grievance, discipline and appeal
requirements.required_screens: Confidential intake, allegations/evidence, hearing/response, recusal, reasoned decision/notice, appeal, remedy/closure
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Preserve real response opportunities and exact notices. Reversal creates corrective employment/payroll work while preserving evidence. Apply actual harassment, dismissal/protected-period and work-rule requirements, not prototype legal shortcuts.

requirements.title: Injury and compensation
requirements.required_screens: Protection/incident link, treatment/absence, official claims/status, compensation/payroll coordination, accommodation/return-to-work
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Employer refusal cannot erase claim rights. Restrict medical fields. Injury absence is not silently annual leave or misconduct. Derive liabilities, protected periods and offsets from current law. Separate rejection/appeal, partial/unknown cash, return restrictions and settlement.

requirements.title: Rules of employment
requirements.required_screens: Clause/version comparison, adverse-impact analysis, consultation/consent, filing/publication/service, effective policy links, challenge/correction
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Apply actual headcount, representation and adverse-change requirements. Receipt is not consent; filing does not cure invalid adoption. Preserve effective versions, reconcile linked policies/calculations and repair orphan rules.

requirements.title: Location and attendance choice
requirements.required_screens: Purpose-specific notice/permission, on-demand check-in, withdrawal/history, manual evidence/confirmation
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Refusal, withdrawal or unavailable GPS never blocks truthful time reporting. No continuous tracking. Default to necessary check-in assessment/evidence, not raw coordinates. Manual confirmation uses the same attendance owner. Browser permission is not lawful basis.

requirements.title: Sources and connections
requirements.required_screens: Discovery, mandate/credentials, capability tests, schemas, cursor/sync/health, rotation/revocation
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Authorized source → scoped connection → actual test/read → schema version → incremental acquisition → reconciliation/repair. Separate read/sign/submit/notice capability, expiry, partial pagination, drift/backoff and stopped credentials. A saved URL is not “connected.”

requirements.title: Ingest, mapping and quality
requirements.required_screens: Inbox, scan/OCR/source viewer, typed mapping, quality, quarantine/repair, publish/replay
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Preserve originals/offsets; parse → validate → account for every item → repair → reviewed dataset or owner-action publication. Separately count failed, duplicate, explicitly ignored and accepted items. Preview/execution share versions; retries do not duplicate effects.

requirements.title: Pipelines
requirements.required_screens: DAG/SQL, branch/diff, tests/preview, schedules, runs/checkpoints/backfill/cancel/retry
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Version → isolated test → publish → trigger → checkpointed run → atomic publication. Handle late/out-of-order inputs, partial failures and superseded runs. Never expose half a dataset or rerun committed actions blindly.

requirements.title: Data products/catalog
requirements.required_screens: Catalog/search, schema/profile, row/column/source lineage, freshness/impact, access, deprecation
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Publish immutable versions with ownership, meaning, grain and quality evidence. Propagate source restrictions; wider access requires reviewed declassification. Lineage metadata cannot reveal deleted/inaccessible secrets.

requirements.title: Ontology
requirements.required_screens: Types/objects/sets/views/links, shared interfaces/properties, cardinality/derived fields, branches/migration/as-of
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Model → validate → preview dependencies → migrate/publish → operate → correct/retire. Preserve typed references, link evidence, history and action compatibility. No silent reinterpretation of money or authority.

requirements.title: Actions, functions and forms
requirements.required_screens: Typed form/action/criteria editor, functions, simulation, review/invocation, Action Log/reversal
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Define descriptor pointing to owner → validate/test → publish → draft/review/execute → receipt. Same invariants for UI/API/import/job/bulk. Arbitrary code cannot directly write approved tables.

requirements.required_screens: Pages/navigation/widgets/queries/actions, variables/events, responsive/persona preview, draft/test/publish/upgrade/retire
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Author governed screens → test scopes/states → publish/run → upgrade/rollback. No unrestricted HTML/JS or privileged query escape. App visibility is not data permission. Existing installations undergo real upgrades.

requirements.title: Analytics/reporting
requirements.required_screens: Object/table/time/geospatial explorer, metrics/grain, charts/pivots/dashboard, drillthrough, reports/distribution/API
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Governed source → explicit metrics → verified drillthrough → publication/export with current recipient authority. Show denominators, coverage, freshness and lineage. Distinguish actuals, forecasts and scenarios; prevent aggregate/export leakage.

requirements.title: Scenarios/optimization
requirements.required_screens: Frozen baseline, assumptions/deltas, constraints/objectives, comparison/map/timeline, solver status, publication
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Freeze → alternatives → deterministic solve → feasible/infeasible/timeout evidence → select → current-state review → owner actions. No live scenario writes or unexplained best-score recommendation.

requirements.title: Tenant/storefront/billing
requirements.responsible_profiles: account holder, tenant operator, billing practitioner
requirements.required_screens: Signup, Group/Company/members, plan/usage, entitlements, invoices/credits, bank instructions/reconciliation
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Immediate free signup → native work → measured entitlements → terms → invoice/transfer record → independent reconciliation. Published prices only. Live collection initially disabled.

requirements.title: Runtime workspace
requirements.required_screens: Home, navigation/search/pins, object panels/comms, views, drafts/recent work, help/preferences
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Resume private work, discover and compare authorized objects, operate across permitted contexts without losing drafts or switching every tab. Revalidate deep links; counts/suggestions cannot leak objects.

requirements.title: Developer projects/workbooks
requirements.required_screens: Projects/branches, SQL/Python/Rust, dependency locks, tests/logs/results, review/publication, API apps/SDK
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Immutable source/runtime → isolated authorized test → publish → bounded execution → lineage/results/proposal. Enforce sandbox, resource/output limits and revoked-token cancellation.

requirements.title: Packages/installation fleet
requirements.required_screens: Bundles/dependencies, signatures/hashes/diffs, compatibility/migration, cohorts, customization/rollback
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Lock dependencies → test clean install/populated upgrade → approve cohort → migrate/verify → advance or compatible rollback. Preserve customizations explicitly. Implement existing-tenant triggers, not merely callable installers.

requirements.title: Operations/resource governance
requirements.required_screens: Service/source/job health, fairness/quotas, incidents/runbooks, audit/rotation, capacity/restore proof
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: Detect → identify affected Company/work/population → assign repair → reconcile/retry → verify/close. Bound global/per-Company work. Distinguish queued/stalled/failed/unknown; preserve operation identity.

requirements.title: HR surveys
requirements.required_workflow_and_acceptance: **B07a HR surveys** provide questionnaire/version/period/electorate setup, participant invitation and typed Likert response, collection/reminders, closure, privacy-safe organizational exploration, retention and destruction.
